OWNER-DRIVEN INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE. The current getting-started page proves one complete alignment, but it cannot carry a library this large by itself. Make it the front door and route readers through five capability journeys, each grounded in runnable Scala, exact output, interpretation, and one useful static figure where a relationship is otherwise hard to see.

1. BUILD A STORY MODEL: inspect source atlas and exact spans; convert checked PENMAN to PropositionChart; show typed acquisition outcomes; inspect entities, situations, contexts, claims, time, causality, and evidence; compose document charts and exact-coreference quotient.
2. REPRESENT HUMAN RECALL: build checked recall units and relations; distinguish source, recall, and external material; run the Autobiographical Interview scoring example.
3. COMPUTE FEATURES: window aligned feature tracks and expose coverage-policy divergence; generate deterministic lexical embeddings and authorized remote requests; compare receipted grakern structural distances.
4. ALIGN AND INTERPRET: build sparse candidates, run GraphHsmm, inspect posterior rows and Viterbi route, then compute RecallSignature with support and missingness. Keep the honest poor lexical result because it teaches why semantic and structural channels matter.
5. SAVE AND REPRODUCE: canonical StoryModelCodec JSON, checksums, provider receipts, and deterministic replay. Treat the proposed output bundle and renderer lowering as future work until its contract actually lands; do not document it as current capability.

Suggested sidebar groups: Start here; Story representation; Recall and interview; Features and alignment; Reproducibility and delivery; API and design reference. The landing page should answer in one screen: input text or an admitted model -> evidence-backed semantic graph -> recall or interview representation -> partial alignment with explicit external states -> support-aware summaries and canonical artifacts.

PAGE CONTRACT: every capability page states the scientific question, shows the smallest public-API program that answers it, prints byte-bound recorded output, explains each important value, names what the result does not establish, and links to the next capability plus API reference. Code alone is not documentation; output alone is not interpretation.

FIGURE SET: source span rail with evidence links; nested context/story graph with time and causal overlays; mention charts with coreference arcs; feature window rail with observed/missing marks and paired policy results; recall-to-story alignment mass plot with external-state mass; structural graph pairs on a distance axis; interview score composition. Every figure needs the exact numeric/text twin for filesystem-only and accessibility use.

COVERAGE BAR: the successor should expose at least one runnable workflow for every major public module family. Existing 8 plus the 5 exact-main workflows already attached here cover core, story, recall, align, interview, embed-core, codec, proposition/amr, acquire, document, features, and embed-grakern. The modules page should be a dependency/capability map, not the only place readers learn that those modules exist.
